achieves.text: A company can buy: it has a purchase office, users with purchasing defaults, order types with their activities, and items that know where they are bought.

tokens.v: The company's parameters say which parts of purchasing are used and how orders are numbered. A purchase office and each site can take those settings or keep their own. A user's profile gives every new order its office, site, warehouse, series and order type. The order type's activities are the steps every order of that type runs through. The item's purchase data, by site and by supplier, fills the order line.
